kicker: For the wait that's gone on long enough to feel normal
truth: You've waited so long for change, you stopped believing it's coming.
prayer: Lord, I've been by this same pool so long that waiting has started to feel like who I am. Ask me again if I want to be whole, and when I say yes, give me strength to rise and walk. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

save: Save this for the wait that's gone on too long
